title: Nice table but difficult to assemble
text: Nice table but difficult to assemble. I thought this table looked like it would be easy peasy to assemble. Nope. Not a lot of steps but the 4 screws for the table legs were so hard to get in. The chairs needed a good deal of pressure to get the legs on. Besides that it’s nice looking. Has a few rough edges though. I’m not sure it should have been priced at $89.
